theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.twoCol_agrees_with_decided_shapes :
twoCol 1 1 = [2, 1] ∧ twoCol 2 2 = [2, 2, 1, 1] ∧ twoCol 0 6 = [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1] ∧ twoCol 1 4 = [2, 1, 1, 1, 1]

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.shape_sets_differ :
[[3], [2, 1]] ≠ [[2, 1], [1, 1, 1]] ∧ [[6], [5, 1], [4, 2], [3, 3]] ≠ [[1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1], [2, 1, 1, 1, 1], [2, 2, 1, 1], [2, 2, 2]]

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.sq_sum_agree_six :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [6] ^ 2 + BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [5, 1] ^ 2 + BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [4, 2] ^ 2 + BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [3, 3] ^ 2 = catalan 6 ∧ BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1] ^ 2 + BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 1, 1, 1, 1] ^ 2 + BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 2, 1, 1] ^ 2 + BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 2, 2] ^ 2 = catalan 6

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.sq_sum_agree_three :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [3] ^ 2 + BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 1] ^ 2 = catalan 3 ∧ BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 1] ^ 2 + BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [1, 1, 1] ^ 2 = catalan 3

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.dim_eq_dim_transpose_three_to_six :
(BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [3] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [1, 1, 1] ∧ BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 1] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 1]) ∧ (BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [4] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [1, 1, 1, 1] ∧ BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [3, 1] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 1, 1] ∧ BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 2] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 2]) ∧ (BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [5] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [1, 1, 1, 1, 1] ∧ BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [4, 1] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 1, 1, 1] ∧ BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [3, 2] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 2, 1]) ∧ BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [6] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1] ∧ BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [5, 1] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 1, 1, 1, 1] ∧ BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [4, 2] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 2, 1, 1] ∧ BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [3, 3] = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [2, 2, 2]

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.dimHLF_two_col_sq_sum (n : ℕ) :
∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n / 2 + 1), ↑(BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF (List.replicate k 2 ++ List.replicate (n - 2 * k) 1)) ^ 2 = ↑(catalan n)

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.dimHLF_two_col_eq_two_row (n k : ℕ) (hk : 2 * k ≤ n) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF (List.replicate k 2 ++ List.replicate (n - 2 * k) 1) = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [n - k, k]

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.dimHLF_twoCol (k m : ℕ) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF (twoCol k m) = BraidKnot.IdentityI.dimHLF [k + m, k]

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.sz_twoCol (k m : ℕ) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.sz (twoCol k m) = BraidKnot.IdentityI.sz [k + m, k]

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.prodHooks_twoCol_eq_twoRow (k m : ℕ) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks (twoCol k m) = BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks [k + m, k]

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.prodHooks_twoRow (a b : ℕ) (hab : b ≤ a) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks [a, b] = ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range b, (a - j + 1)) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ico b a, (a - j)) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range b, (b - j)

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.prodHooks_twoCol (k m : ℕ) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks (twoCol k m) = ((∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (k + m - i + 1)) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (k - i)) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.Ico k (k + m), (k + m - i)

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.prodHooks_eq (l : List ℕ) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks l = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range l.length, ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (l.getD i 0), (l.getD i 0 - j + (BraidKnot.IdentityI.colLen l j - i) - 1)

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.twoRow_colLen (a b j : ℕ) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.colLen [a, b] j = (if j < a then 1 else 0) + if j < b then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.twoCol_getD_ge (k m i : ℕ) (h1 : k ≤ i) (h2 : i < k + m) :
(twoCol k m).getD i 0 = 1

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.twoCol_getD_lt (k m i : ℕ) (h : i < k) :
(twoCol k m).getD i 0 = 2

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.twoCol_colLen_one (k m : ℕ) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.colLen (twoCol k m) 1 = k

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.twoCol_colLen_zero (k m : ℕ) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.colLen (twoCol k m) 0 = k + m

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.twoCol_length (k m : ℕ) :
(twoCol k m).length = k + m

(∃ (μ : YoungDiagram), AtMostTwoRows μ ∧ ¬AtMostTwoCols μ ∧ μ.card = 3) ∧ ∃ (μ : YoungDiagram), AtMostTwoCols μ ∧ ¬AtMostTwoRows μ ∧ μ.card = 3

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.exists_atMostTwoCols_not_atMostTwoRows :
∃ (μ : YoungDiagram), AtMostTwoCols μ ∧ ¬AtMostTwoRows μ ∧ μ.card = 3

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.atMostTwoRows_iff_atMostTwoCols_false :

theorem QOU.MassTheory.TwoRowTwoColumn.row3_rowLen :
